selection: One common candidate: minimum mean selected validation balanced NLL across four architecture/OEO arms at depth4 seed17; no test access and no gap-based selection.
data_split: Per class 70% train, remaining equally split validation/test with fixed RNG20260917 after exact deduplication. All eight classes, no patient independence claim.
encoding: Original 150x150 RGB -> bicubic antialias100 clamp -> shared train-only affine -> bilinear50 -> fixed [R,G;B,meanRGB] amplitude100. D2NN each tile is independently enlarged to fill its phase aperture and incident power restored.
scope: Architecture/optimization benchmark; no clinical performance claim, no guarantee of a desired model ranking.
